name: Shopify Speed Check
author: Skai Digital
description: Remote MCP server for Shopify stores: Google PageSpeed Insights scores for mobile and desktop, real-user Core Web Vitals from the Chrome UX Report, the apps and scripts slowing the store down, theme and headless detection, and a Shopify Basic to Plus fee comparison. No API key or account needed. Endpoint: https://tools.skaidigital.com/mcp

tools.name: check_shopify_store_speed
tools.description: Test a Shopify store's speed with Google PageSpeed Insights (mobile and desktop) and real-user Core Web Vitals, list the apps and scripts slowing it down, and estimate what a headless build could change, with its assumptions. Takes 10 seconds to 2.5 minutes; results are cached for 24 hours.

strategy.description: Which Lighthouse runs to include; defaults to both.

tools.name: detect_shopify_store
tools.description: Detect whether a site is a Shopify theme store or a headless Shopify storefront, and which theme it uses. Fetches only the public page; runs no speed test.

tools.name: calculate_shopify_fees
tools.description: Compare the monthly and annual cost of Shopify Basic, Grow, Advanced and Plus for a sales volume and payment mix, with break-even sales between plans and requirements only Plus covers. Uses Shopify's published US prices; the variable Plus platform fee is unpublished, so pass plusQuoteMonthly if you have a quote. Only monthlyGmv is required; the rest defaults to one brand fully on Shopify Payments with yearly billing.

monthlyGmv.description: Monthly online sales in USD across all stores.

averageOrderValue.description: Average order value in USD; drives the per-order fixed card fee.

billing.description: Billing for Basic, Grow and Advanced.

shopifyPaymentsShare.description: Share of online sales processed by Shopify Payments (0-1); the rest uses a third-party provider.

premiumCardShare.description: Share of Shopify Payments sales on premium cards (0-1).

internationalCardShare.description: Share of Shopify Payments sales on international cards (0-1).

providerRateBps.description: Third-party provider's own rate in basis points (290 = 2.9%).

providerFixedCents.description: Third-party provider's own fixed fee per order in cents.

sameBrandStores.description: Stores for the same brand, such as regional stores.

brands.description: Separate brands; each needs its own plan or Plus contract.

checkoutExtensions.description: Whether checkout UI extensions are needed.

staffAccounts.description: Staff accounts needed besides the store owner.

plusQuoteMonthly.description: Monthly Plus price from a Shopify quote; replaces the list price.
